blocks.text: Having a worn tooth or one that’s damaged can interfere with eating and smiling. But you don’t need to deal with ongoing discomfort or self-consciousness when you choose dental restorations. Our dentist in Wyoming, OH, at Wyoming Family Dentistry offers restorative dentistry services for beautiful smiles!
This type of dental care goes beyond brightening your smile — it helps your teeth function better while also boosting their appearance. Dental restorations bring you all of the following benefits:

items: Allow you to chew and speak comfortably
Lower chance of advanced dental problems in the affected teeth

blocks.text: What Types of Restoration Solutions Are Available?
Choosing restorative dentistry in Wyoming, OH, means you have different options to consider, depending on what’s wrong with your tooth or teeth. Some of these solutions include the following.

These caps are designed to cover your tooth for added strength and protection from damage. Crowns come in different materials, including metal for back teeth and tooth-colored porcelain or ceramic for front teeth.
These structures are used to replace one or more teeth, using crowns on adjacent teeth to hold the whole bridge in place.
Dental implants replace teeth with a post that acts like a new tooth root and a custom artificial tooth, such as a crown.
Resin inlays cover the cusps of your back teeth, keeping them safe from damage. Onlays extend beyond the cusps, but don’t cover the whole tooth as crowns do.
Dental fillings help keep teeth safe after the removal of decayed material. Metal fillings are durable for molars and premolars, while composite resin fillings offer a natural look for front teeth.
Full dentures give you a whole set of teeth if you’ve lost yours due to severe decay or damage. Partial dentures replace a few or several missing teeth.
